title: ISO/IEC 19395:2015 — Smart Data Centre Resource Monitoring and Control — Scope
text:
ISO/IEC 19395:2015 — Information technology — Sustainability for and by information technology — Smart data centre resource monitoring and control (adopted from ECMA-400)

Scope: Provides Messages that facilitate integrated or 'smart' monitoring and control of Resources in data centre islands (IT, electrical energy/power, and cooling/fluid). Resources may be composed of other Resources (e.g. a rack may contain servers, ventilators). Servers may be viewed from computing, energy consumption or dissipation aspects modelled as Resource Components grouped into IT, power and fluid Domains.

The standard defines:
- CIM-based information model for data centre resources
- Three resource domains: IT Domain, Power Domain, Fluid Domain
- Message formats for GET/SET commands and event notification
- Metrics for CPU utilization, power consumption, cooling efficiency

Key concepts:
- Management Function: the controlling system
- Resource: any monitored/controlled data centre component
- Resource Component: subcomponent within a Resource
- CIM (Common Information Model): basis for the information schema

title: Smart data centre — Terms, definitions and acronyms
text:
ISO/IEC 19395:2015 — Clause 4: Terms, definitions and acronyms

Key terms:
- CIM (Common Information Model): industry-standard information model for IT management
- CIM_System: top-level CIM entity representing a managed system
- CIM_Component: CIM entity representing a component within a system
- CIM_BaseMetricDefinition: definition of a measurable metric
- CIM_BaseMetricValue: measured value of a metric
- CIM_MetricDefForME: association between a metric definition and a managed element
- CIM_MetricInstance: instance of a metric measurement
- CIM_RegisteredProfile: registered management profile
- CIM_SystemDevice: device within a system
- CIM_NumericSensor: numeric sensor entity
- SDC (Smart Data Centre): data centre with integrated monitoring and control
- CRAH (Computer Room Air Handler): cooling unit
- PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness): ratio of total facility power to IT equipment power
- DCiE (Data Centre infrastructure Efficiency): reciprocal of PUE
- IT load: power consumed by IT equipment
- Fluid domain: cooling infrastructure components
- Power domain: electrical power infrastructure
- IT domain: computing infrastructure

title: Smart data centre — Domains and resource model
text:
ISO/IEC 19395:2015 — Clause 5: Domains

5.2 Base Domain: Core CIM entities shared across all domains.
- CIM_System: represents the entire managed data centre system
- CIM_BaseMetricDefinition/Value: metric definition and measurement framework
- CIM_MetricDefForME: links metrics to managed elements
- CIM_MetricInstance: individual metric readings
- CIM_RegisteredProfile: compliance profiles
- CIM_SystemDevice, CIM_Component: device hierarchy
- Metrics for fluid measurements: flow rate, temperature, pressure
- CIM_NumericSensor: sensor readings
- CIM_EnabledLogicalElementCapabilities: operational capabilities

5.3 IT Domain: Computing resources.
- Servers, storage, network equipment
- CPU utilization metrics
- Memory utilization
- Network throughput
- Storage I/O metrics

5.4 Power Domain: Electrical power infrastructure.
- UPS, PDU (Power Distribution Units)
- Power consumption measurement
- Power efficiency metrics
- Input/output power monitoring

5.5 Fluid Domain: Cooling infrastructure.
- SDC_FluidConnection: cooling fluid connections
- SDC_FluidElement: fluid system components
- SDC_FluidMeasurementPoint: measurement locations
- SDC_FluidTransferPort: fluid transfer interfaces
- SDC_CoolingSystem: complete cooling system entity
- SDC_CoolingSettingData: cooling configuration parameters

Clauses 6-7: Properties and Messages (GET/SET commands, event subscription and notification for real-time monitoring).
